map.后景深约为前者的两倍，对焦位置宜略偏向背景一侧: The rear depth of field is about twice the front, so focus slightly toward the background side
map.当对焦距离超过超焦距时远点为无限远，风光拍摄对焦到超焦距可最大化清晰范围: When the focus distance exceeds the hyperfocal distance the far point is infinity, so focusing at the hyperfocal distance maximises the sharp range for landscape work
map.缩小光圈会增加景深，但也可能因衍射降低锐度，f/8–f/11 常是平衡点: Stopping down increases depth of field but can reduce sharpness through diffraction; f/8–f/11 is often the balance point
